# Validation geometry and oscillator-strength error audit

Created 2026-09-29T03:16:38.827786+08:00 (Asia/Shanghai). Validation-only descriptive analysis; no fitting, inference, test access, or sample removal.

## Fixed geometry definition and bins

centered unweighted coordinate covariance X.T@X/n_atoms in FP64; eigenvalues descending. Ratios are undefined when lambda1 <= 64*eps64*max(trace(cov),1). Near-linear means q2 <= 1e-5.

Train-derived q2 quantiles (0.1%, 1%, 10%, 50%): [0.05941956341810567, 0.09867099135475822, 0.21033971729099188, 0.45009813312285296]. After adding 1e-5 and deduplicating, boundaries are [1e-05, 0.05941956341810567, 0.09867099135475822, 0.21033971729099188, 0.45009813312285296]. The intervals are left-open/right-closed after the first `[0,b0]` bin; degenerate rows are reported separately.

Train/validation degenerates: 0/0. Near-linear train/validation: 10/1.

## Low-q2 concentration check

The strict near-linear validation bin contains only molecule 14562, so there is no independent validation replicate under q2 <= 1e-5. The next low-q2 bin contains 5 other molecules. The two lowest bins together contain six molecules and contribute eta0 SSE share 5.717% and equal3 SSE share 6.028%. This total includes molecule 14562 and is descriptive.

| Predictor | Six-molecule SSE share | Mean SSE per molecule, six incl. case | SSE in next bin after removing case for concentration only | Next-bin median SSE/mol | Next-bin P90 SSE/mol |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| eta0 | 5.716978% | 0.897614364 | 2.48768331 | 0.460131213 | 0.984108031 |
| equal3 | 6.027534% | 0.876153049 | 1.66037739 | 0.0935150365 | 0.842237772 |

The “after removing case” column is only a concentration diagnostic: the full validation benchmark and all main-stratum metrics still retain every molecule. The five-molecule low-q2 group has elevated median and P90 per-molecule SSE versus the higher-q2 strata, which is consistent with a broader low-shape-ratio error population but does not establish a causal geometry effect.

## Limits

- Geometry associations are descriptive and do not establish causality or label errors.
- Exact raw-f zeros are reported as supplied; no claim is made that labels are erroneous.
- All benchmark metrics include every validation molecule; molecule 14562 is isolated only for concentration accounting.
- Equal3 is the arithmetic mean of three saved validation native-f predictions; no new inference or fitted weights.
- No test indices, test labels, test geometries, test predictions, or test metrics were accessed.

Source hashes, IDs, source indices, raw FP64 truths/masks and prediction alignment are recorded in `geometry_error_metrics.json`. No training, test access, or source-model inference was performed.
